1. (S) SITUATION:
{TaskForceName} is departing Severomorsk as the Northern Fleet enters wartime operations. NATO hunter-killer submarines and maritime patrol aircraft are already searching the Barents Sea. The enemy intends to contain the task force before it reaches open water.
2. (S) MISSION: 2.1 Bring the task force through the patrol zone. 2.2 {FlagshipName} must survive.
3. (S) EXECUTION: 3.1 Advance through the marked patrol area at best practical speed. 3.2 Use helicopters, sonar, and available reconnaissance to clear the route ahead. 3.3 Employ the task force's long-range weapons against threats that attempt to surface or close the formation. 3.4 Maintain formation integrity until the Norwegian Sea exit is secured.
4. (S) ENEMY SITUATION: 4.1 NATO submarines are operating inside the Barents Sea cordon. 4.2 Maritime patrol aircraft are expected to support the submarine screen.
5. (S) FRIENDLY SITUATION: 5.1 {TaskForceName} is the principal Soviet surface strike group in the operation. 5.2 Organic helicopters and sensors are available for anti-submarine screening.
6. (S) INTEL ASSESSMENT: 6.1 NATO is aware that the Northern Fleet has sortied and will attempt to delay or destroy the task force before breakout. 6.2 Expect the heaviest resistance near the marked breakthrough area. Preserve the flagship and maintain momentum.
